games.name: Absolvement [ALPHA]
games.desc:
An end of a lifetime, or the beginning of an era? Nobody knows what lies at the end. In fact, most believe there is no end. You struggle to differentiate between your true memories and false ones planted from your fleeting consciousness as you shatter your body but not your soul.

<> Absolvement is currently in the ALPHA development stage. <>
Fundamentals of the game may change as we release updates!

- Play solo or in parties up to 5 players
- Branded by sins, affixes, and burdens - freely choose your rate of progression and your own personal difficulty
- Classless character design and progression
- Over 130 abilities to use and build synergies with
- Earn Soul Fragments when your character wipes to unlock 200+ buffs in the Soul Tree for your next character

Absolvement is a roguelite dungeon crawler developed by Amorian Skies.
Nominated in the 2025 Creator Awards for Best Narrative.
All in-game music is our own composed OST! 
Playable on PC and Console with controller support.

games.name: Stand Power
games.desc:
"Stand Power" is largely inspired by the series "JoJo's Bizarre Adventure".

COMMANDS:
!rejoin -> Allows you to rejoin the same server in-game.
!pity -> Displays your current shiny stand chance pity percentage.
!trade (player name) -> Sends a STAND trade request to the specified player.
!confirm (player name) -> Confirms the TRADE REQUEST that you've sent.
!accept (player name) -> Both parties must enter this command to finalize the trade (this comes after the "!confirm" command).
!giveitem (player name) -> Gives the targeted player the item you're currently holding.

🌐Available on:

・💻 PC
・📱 MOBILE
・🎮 CONSOLE (Note: A keyboard and mouse are required for gameplay)

💻PC Controls:
・F to BLOCK
・L to open INVENTORY
・CTRL to RUN

games.name: Altitorture [2 Player Obby]
games.desc:
⚠️ This game is made for 2 players, to get the best experience play with a friend. ⚠️

Climb your way out of a deep pit with your friend in this obby game. The pit is unforgiving and the climb is tough, but you’re not alone. You and your friend are attached via an elastic rope that will test your teamwork and coordination. Learn how to use the rope to your advantage and overcome the challenges of being dependent on each other. Can you make it to the top?

How to start:
 - Go up to someone you'd like to pair up with.
 - Press the "Request rope" button.
 - To accept a request simply go up a requesting person and request a rope back.
 - You're set, have fun!

⛰️ Current maximum altitude: 600 M

Developer credits: Maxiimized [Building | Scripting], R0T1CAL [Building | Scripting], FlowingHourglass [Building]
